news.title: OpenAI surpasses $25 billion in annualized revenue, taking early steps toward public listing

tech.title: Run Your Own AI Model Locally: A Practical Ollama Setup Guide (2026)
tech.snippet: With Ollama, you can run capable language models on a laptop or desktop — no API keys, no subscriptions, no internet required. Here's a practical guide to getting set up, choosing the right model, and actually using local AI for something useful.
